clue.text: Split up motor-accessory firm

definitions.meaning: to separate or go different ways
read literally, a company that makes parts for cars

explanation.surface: A car-parts business has broken up.
explanation.definitionFit: To part company is the idiom for separating; read literally it is a business selling spares.

clue.text: A fish jelly

parts.note: the gar is a long-snouted fish

explanation.surface: Fish in aspic.
explanation.definitionFit: A gelatinous substance from seaweed used as a setting agent.

clue.text: Be prepared to accept capture

definitions.meaning: to agree to receive
to seize

explanation.surface: Getting ready to accept being caught.
explanation.definitionFit: To take is to receive willingly, and also to seize a piece or a prisoner.

clue.text: A fruitful field of production

parts.note: read literally, ground planted to bear fruit, not a productive sphere of work

explanation.surface: A productive area of industry.
explanation.definitionFit: Fruit trees grow in an enclosed plot planted for harvest.

clue.text: Support for piano

parts.note: pro means in favour of
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, soft

explanation.surface: Something to hold up a piano.
explanation.definitionFit: A prop is something that holds a thing up.

clue.text: Crease-resistant wood of course

definitions.meaning: of fabric that does not need pressing
on a golf course a wood is a club that is not an iron

explanation.surface: Timber that never wrinkles, naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabric that needs no pressing; and a golf wood is literally a club not of the iron type.

clue.text: Happy mood inculcated by guardian angels

definitions.meaning: cheerfulness
benevolent protecting beings

explanation.surface: Cheerfulness instilled by heavenly protectors.
explanation.definitionFit: Being cheerful is being in a jolly temper; angels are literally kindly supernatural beings.

clue.text: Ironing instructions which make the news

definitions.meaning: a notice telling you to press a garment
an announcement issued to newspapers

explanation.surface: Laundry labels that end up in the headlines.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally a label saying a garment should be pressed; also a statement released to journalists.

clue.text: Sullen party goes to a Sumerian site

parts.note: a do is an informal word for a party
Ur is the ancient Sumerian city in Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: A gloomy guest heads off to an archaeological dig in Iraq.
explanation.definitionFit: Both describe someone grim, unsmiling and stern.

clue.text: A tale of the riverside which is given credit

indicators.note: the tale is said to be of the riverside, so the riverside word comes first

parts.note: a bank is the edge of a river
an account is a story or narrative

explanation.surface: A story set by the river earns somebody praise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of the' puts the riverside piece in front of the tale. 'Credit' looks like praise but is the banking sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank account is where a customer's money is held and credited.

clue.text: Strangely enough they could be evens

definitions.text: Strangely enough they could be evens

parts.words: Strangely enough they could be evens
parts.note: a betting price can be quoted at evens, yet the word for such prices also means strange or uneven numbers

explanation.surface: A paradox about numbers that are uneven yet even.
explanation.definitionFit: Betting prices are quoted as odds, and evens is one such price, while odd is also the opposite of even.

clue.text: A large schnapps produces incoherent speech

definitions.meaning: a double measure of Dutch gin
gibberish

explanation.surface: A big drink leads to slurred talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally two measures of Dutch spirit; idiomatically, unintelligible gibberish.

clue.text: Ancient name gathers support

indicators.note: the two words are gathered up together and their letters reassembled

explanation.surface: An old title attracts backing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gathers' signals that ANCIENT NAME is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Maintenance is financial support, as paid to a former spouse.

clue.text: Not necessarily Socialist rhetoric

definitions.meaning: the speaker may be a Conservative instead
the art of public speaking

explanation.surface: Political speech-making is not the preserve of the Left.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as OR A TORY: a Tory is a member of Britain's Conservative Party, the opposite of a Socialist.
explanation.definitionFit: Oratory is eloquent public speaking, which is what rhetoric is.

clue.text: Rustic couple over fifty

indicators.note: in a down answer one piece sits above the other

parts.note: to yoke is to join together
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A country pair aged over fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: A yokel is an unsophisticated country person.

clue.text: Why the ball nips back to the highest point?

definitions.text: Why the ball nips back to the highest point?

parts.note: the top is the highest point

indicators.note: the word nips is read backwards, as the clue says it goes back

explanation.surface: A question about what makes a tennis ball kick up off the court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns NIPS into SPIN, placed after TOP.
explanation.definitionFit: Forward rotation imparted to a ball makes it dip and kick on bouncing.

clue.text: When students must attend to specific names

definitions.meaning: periods of the academic year
words used for particular things

explanation.surface: Term-time rules about attendance and naming.
explanation.definitionFit: Academic periods are terms, and technical words are terms.

clue.text: Old fellow with the same ardent desire

parts.note: do, short for ditto, means the same
a yen is a longing

explanation.surface: An elderly man shares the same passion.
explanation.walkthrough: DO (ditto) is a crossword convention for 'the same'.
explanation.definitionFit: The senior, most respected member of a group is its doyen.

clue.text: An inclination to be dishonest

definitions.meaning: a natural leaning or aptitude
slang for crooked or corrupt

explanation.surface: Someone with a tendency towards crookedness.
explanation.definitionFit: A bent is a natural leaning; as slang, a bent copper is a corrupt one.

clue.text: Father needs it for glazing

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest's title

explanation.surface: Dad wants it to finish the windows.
explanation.definitionFit: Frit is the fused mixture of materials used to make glass and ceramic glazes.

clue.text: Waves on the pools

definitions.meaning: curls set into the hair
permutations of matches entered on a football pools coupon

explanation.surface: Ripples on swimming pools.
explanation.walkthrough: The football pools are a British betting game on match results; a perm is a combination of selections.
explanation.definitionFit: A perm is a hair treatment giving lasting curls, and also short for a permutation on the pools.

clue.text: A canape served up as a remedy for all ailments

indicators.note: the snack is presented in a new form, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An hors d'oeuvre offered as a cure-all.
explanation.definitionFit: A cure-all claimed to treat every illness.

clue.text: Got into very hot water

parts.note: read literally, burnt by boiling liquid rather than landed in trouble

explanation.surface: Someone landed in serious trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: To be burnt by hot liquid or steam is to be literally harmed by very hot water.

clue.text: Point learnt afresh for all time

parts.note: E, east, is a compass point

indicators.note: the letters are learnt again in a new form, so rearranged

explanation.surface: A lesson learned anew will last forever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'afresh' rearranges LEARNT to TERNAL, after E.
explanation.definitionFit: Something everlasting endures without end.

clue.text: He has doubts about entering contaminated housing

indicators.note: the 'about' letter goes into the word for contaminated

parts.note: septic means infected
c, circa, means about

explanation.surface: A man is uneasy about moving into infected accommodation.
explanation.walkthrough: C (circa) goes inside SEPTIC; 'housing' merely completes the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A doubter questions accepted beliefs.

clue.text: Not down as a poisonous tree

parts.note: the opposite of down is up

explanation.surface: Standing tall like a toxic tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The upas is a Javanese tree whose sap is used as arrow poison.

clue.text: During it soldiers do right to give assistance

parts.note: aid means help

explanation.surface: Soldiers do the right thing to help.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a cryptic description: an attack is something soldiers carry out.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden military attack is an operation troops carry out.

clue.text: It won't run quickly

definitions.meaning: a colourfast dye does not bleed in the wash
at speed

explanation.surface: Something that refuses to hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: Colours fixed so they do not bleed are fast, and fast also means at speed.

clue.text: Trepidation produced by a loud organ

parts.note: f, forte, means loud in music
the ear is the organ of hearing

explanation.surface: Anxiety caused by a booming church organ.
explanation.definitionFit: Trepidation is nervous dread.

clue.text: Boxing-promoter from the rag-and-bone trade

definitions.meaning: one who deals in scraps, that is fights
a rag-and-bone man collects old junk to sell

explanation.surface: A fight promoter with a past in junk collecting.
explanation.walkthrough: A rag-and-bone man is a British street collector of unwanted household goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrap is a fight, so a fight promoter deals in them; literally, a dealer in scrap metal.

clue.text: Prepare to shoot a male pheasant

definitions.meaning: to raise a gun's hammer before firing
the male of a game bird

explanation.surface: Readying a gun against a pheasant.
explanation.definitionFit: One cocks a gun to fire it, and the male of the pheasant is so called.

clue.text: Frank has a true disposition to seek standing as a politician

parts.note: candid means frank

indicators.note: a disposition is an arrangement, so these letters are set out anew

explanation.surface: An honest person has the temperament to run for office.
explanation.definitionFit: Candidature is the state of being a candidate for election.
